gloss: catching all at once; sweeping roundup

definitions.gloss: catching all at once; sweeping roundup; rounding up everyone
definitions.explanation: Capturing or dealing with all members of a group in a single sweep. Originally from a Chinese idiom meaning to catch all fish in one cast of the net. Often used for police raids or decisive actions that eliminate an entire group at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一網打尽|いちもうだじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To round up all the criminals at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一網打尽|いちもうだじん}にした。
examples.english: The police rounded up the entire fraud ring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{密輸|みつゆ}→密輸：20266_mitsuyu⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一網打尽|いちもうだじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: After years of investigation, they succeeded in rounding up the entire smuggling organization.

notes:
Four-character compound (yojijukugo): ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + {網|もう} (net) + {打|だ} (strike) + {尽|じん} (exhaust, all). Literally "to exhaust with one cast of the net." From a Chinese historical anecdote.

USAGE:
Almost always used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ in the pattern ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一網打尽|いちもうだじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Most commonly used in crime and law enforcement contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一網打尽|いちもうだじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to round up ~ all at once)
- {一網打尽|いちもうだじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧ (to catch all at once)
